sections.h2: Only 24 of 207 functional CBG plants connect to a city gas pipeline

chart.title: Most functional plants have no pipeline link, and 148 have no plan for one
chart.sub: Functional CBG plants by connectivity status, number of plants.
chart.source: PNGRB, Connectivity and Performance Report FY 2025-26 (August 2026).

sections.means: Of the 207 plants producing gas today, 24 can inject it straight into a city gas network.
sections.todo: Track the 15 plants building connections and the 20 with proposals before the 3% step-up in FY2026-27.

sections.h2: Commissioned plants reached 4.3% of the 5,000-plant SATAT target

chart.title: Seven years after launch, the count is a small fraction of the original goal
chart.source: PRS India; Energetica India; PIB GOBARdhan backgrounder (6 August 2026).

sections.means: Commissioning reached 217 plants by August 2026, against a 5,000-plant target first due in 2023-24.
sections.todo: Use the 339 plants under construction as the next check on whether the commissioned count keeps rising.

sections.h2: The blending obligation rises from 1% to 5% of CNG and piped-gas supply

chart.title: The mandate steps up each year, from 1% in FY2025-26 to 5% from FY2028-29
chart.sub: Compressed Biogas Blending Obligation, minimum share of CNG and piped-gas sales, %.

sections.means: FY2025-26 was reported at about 1.05% of sales, against a 1% requirement.
sections.todo: Check the step to 3% in FY2026-27 against the 24 pipeline-connected plants that can feed city networks.
